_comment: Per-item overrides for Invoke-WsoContentTest.ps1 (see UEM-API-TESTING-SPEC.md). Keyed by the inventory Name column. Anything not listed here is tested with the defaults: a Script is expected to report Completed (exit 0) on every test device, a Sensor is expected to report a value that parses as its declared Data Type. Keys: skip (reason string: never tested), expect (Completed | Failed), variables (name -> value for $env:-backed parameters), match (regex the sensor value must satisfy), min / max (numeric bounds for Integer sensors), allowEmpty (true when an empty String value is acceptable), expectNoValue (true for a Boolean/DateTime sensor that emits nothing when its data source is absent; Hub rejects an empty typed value, so 'no value stored' is the pass condition on a device without the product), timeoutMinutes (per-item override of the wait for a result), note (free text carried into the result file). Expectations marked 'lab VM' assume the disposable VMware lab build (no Wi-Fi, no Trellix, no SCOM, no Office). Revisit them on a product VM.

Invoke-SimpleReboot.ps1.skip: Reboots the test device mid-run. Validate by hand with the reboot break test.

Invoke_RebootWithUserDefer_1.2.0.7.ps1.skip: Reboots the test device after the deferral window.

DEX_Invoke-SignoffWindows.ps1.skip: Signs the console user off the test device.

DEX_Start-LockDeviceSoft.ps1.skip: Locks the console session of the test device.

DEX_LockDevice-BitlockEncryptionActivate.skip: Suspends BitLocker protectors and powers the test device off. Validate by hand per TEST-VALIDATION.md 9.2.

DEX_Stop-WindowsUpdate.ps1.skip: Disables Windows Update and sets a 35-day pause on the test device. Validate by hand per TEST-VALIDATION.md 9.4.

DEX_Start-WindowsUpdate.ps1.skip: Forces an update install on the test device, which can leave it pending a restart mid-sweep. Validate by hand per TEST-VALIDATION.md 9.5.

Start-UserProfileCleanup.ps1.skip: Deletes user profiles. No dry-run mode; validate by hand per General-Testing-Guide.md section 2.2.

Invoke-AutoRemediateNetworkStack.ps1.skip: Can sever the test device's network connection (adapter reset, Winsock reset). Covered by its break test.

Start-DefenderFullScan.ps1.skip: Starts a multi-hour Defender full scan on the test device and slows every later case. Validate by hand per TEST-VALIDATION.md 4.7.

Invoke-AutoRemediateSCOMAgent.ps1.skip: Reference copy only: 48,336 characters exceeds the UEM 32,767 limit and the create call will be refused. Parts 1-3 are the deployable split.

Restart-WinService.ps1.note: Print Spooler exists on every Windows build and restarts cleanly.

Restart-WinProcess.ps1.skip: Needs a running target process on the test device. Fixed 2026-10-29 and verified by hand (TEST-VALIDATION.md 5.9). Set variables (FileDescription, StartService) and remove this skip to test through UEM.

Restart-WinProcessGraceful.ps1.skip: Needs a running target process and an interactive user on the test device. Set variables (FileDescription, Mode, Restart) and remove this skip to test.

Invoke-AutoRemediateDriverIssues.ps1.note: Filter matches the VMware devices on the lab VM. Scan/Restart only by default; the escalation chain is covered by the unit tests and break tests.

Invoke-DriverUpdates.ps1.note: Detect mode exits 1 whenever any driver update is offered, which UEM shows as Failed. The no-match filter pins exit 0 and proves the variables reach the script. Install mode is a manual test (TEST-VALIDATION.md 5.2).

Invoke-AutoRemediateWiFiSignalIssues.ps1.note: Lab VM has no Wi-Fi adapter, so step 1 fails by design and the script exits 1. Remove this expectation on a device with a wireless adapter.

Invoke-TrellixRefreshPolicies.ps1.note: Throws 'CmdAgent.exe was not found' without Trellix installed. Pins the guard on the lab VM; remove on a Trellix device.

Invoke-TrellixLocalUpdate.ps1.note: Without Trellix both executables are reported as not found and the script exits 0. Completed on the lab VM proves only the skip path.

Invoke-CrowdStrikeServiceRemediation.ps1.note: No Falcon on the lab VM; Completed proves only the 'nothing to remediate' path. Fixed 2026-10-29.

Invoke-TrendMicroServiceRemediation.ps1.note: No Trend Micro on the lab VM; Completed proves only the not-found path.

Invoke-AutoRemediateOutlook.ps1.note: Outlook is not on the lab VM; Completed proves only the [Skipped] path.

Invoke-AutoRemediateTeams.ps1.note: Teams is not on the lab VM; Completed proves only the [Skipped] path.

Invoke-AutoRemediateZoom.ps1.note: Zoom is not on the lab VM; Completed proves only the [Skipped] path.

Invoke-AutoRemediateAppXBloat.ps1.note: Deprovisions consumer inbox AppX packages on the test device. Expected and acceptable on a disposable VM; the first run changes the image.

Enable-HardwareAcceleratedGPUScheduling..note: Exits 1 on the run that enables HwSchMode (no re-detect) and 0 on every later run. A Failed verdict on a fresh device is expected once; re-run to confirm.

Invoke-RemediatePageFile.ps1.note: Exits 1 (Warning) when the page file is manually sized but under threshold, or system-managed with high usage. On the lab VM the page file is system-managed, so Completed is expected.

Start-ClearRecycleBin.ps1.note: Empties every user's Recycle Bin on the test device. Keep the test smart group to disposable VMs.

Invoke-AutoRemediateSCOMHealthServiceCac.skip: SCOM agent is not installed on the lab VM. Expected to exit non-zero there, which proves nothing.

Invoke-AutoRemediateSCOMClonedIdentity.p.skip: SCOM agent is not installed on the lab VM.

Invoke-AutoRemediateSCOMMonitoringHost.p.note: No SCOM agent on the lab VM: the launcher dispatches, the payload reports Skipped:NoAgent and exits 0. Completed proves the launcher and task plumbing only.

sensor-getservice.ps1.skip: Sample only: emits the JSON list of every running service (about 2.4 KB). UEM stores at most 1 KB per sensor value and Hub drops the sample ('output length is greater than 1KB length', seen 2026-10-29).

Get-UserProfileSize.ps1.skip: Not sensor-shaped: writes 34 lines of log text, references an undefined CustomPSObject type and exits 1. Hub rejected it as 'failed sanity' on 2026-10-29. Needs a rewrite that emits one value before it can be a sensor.

performance_defender_scanorupdateactive..note: Hub rejected 1.0.0 as 'failed sanity' on both lab devices (2026-10-29) while an interactive run printed Idle. 1.0.1 silences the Get-WinEvent error stream; confirmed Idle on both devices in run 0501f4.

logon_folder_redirection_map.ps1.note: Payload was ~1.2 KB and Hub dropped it as over 1 KB on 2026-10-29; the tenant's own published copy fails the same way on every sample. Restructured the same day (redirected targets plus local folder names); confirmed stored on both devices in run 0501f4.

logon_folder_redirection_latency_probe.p.note: Payload was ~2.5 KB and Hub dropped it as over 1 KB on 2026-10-29. Restructured the same day (probe details only for redirected folders); confirmed stored on both devices in run 0501f4.

logon_time.ps1.note: Lab VMs hold LogonTime = Unknown in the LogonDuration cache, so the sensor emits nothing and Hub rejects the empty DateTime. Passes with a value on a device where Measure-LogonDuration.ps1 has parsed a logon.

logon_shell_ready_time.ps1.note: Same cache state as logon_time.ps1 on the lab VMs.

logon_gp_start_time.ps1.note: Same cache state as logon_time.ps1 on the lab VMs.

vpn_last_connect_time.ps1.note: No VPN client on the lab VMs, so the cache has no LastConnectTime and the DateTime sensor emits nothing by design.

vpn_dns_configured.ps1.note: Documented: no value is emitted without an active tunnel, because false would read as a real finding.

scom_management_server_reachable.ps1.note: No SCOM agent on the lab VMs; the sensor returns without output when AgentInstalled is absent.

scom_healthservice_running_standalone.ps.note: No SCOM agent root on the lab VMs; the sensor returns without output by design.

vpn_adapter_name.ps1.note: Empty by design without a VPN adapter (lab VMs).

vpn_health_reason.ps1.note: Empty by design when the VPN cache has no HealthReason (lab VMs).

scom_agent_health_reason.ps1.note: Empty by design without a SCOM agent (lab VMs).

scom_agent_version.ps1.note: Empty by design without a SCOM agent (lab VMs).

scom_agent_version_standalone.ps1.note: Empty by design without a SCOM agent (lab VMs).
